about.story:
Bella Luxe Salon & Spa was founded in the vibrant streets of Bandra with a vision to combine modern European hairdressing artistry with holistic wellness rituals.

Every member of our styling crew is internationally trained and dedicated to giving you an experience that leaves you feeling renewed, radiant, and empowered.

faq.question: Do you accept walk-in clients or is prior booking required?
faq.answer: While we welcome walk-ins whenever a chair is available, we strongly recommend reserving your slot via WhatsApp to guarantee zero waiting time.

faq.question: What hair color brands do you work with?
faq.answer: We exclusively stock premium salon brands like L’Oréal Professionnel Série Expert, Wella Professionals, and Olaplex bond repair.

faq.question: Is valet or street parking available?
faq.answer: Yes, convenient street parking and nearby mall parking lots are easily accessible along Hill Road Bandra.
